stages.name: forecast_locked_before_delivery
stages.note: every accepted Referral delivery needs a forecast locked before it, and every verdict must show that forecast

stages.name: fabrication_rejected
stages.note: the buyer paid a worker whose citations are fabricated

stages.name: rematched_and_accepted
stages.note: after the rejection the buyer must rematch with the fabricator excluded, and pay the worker whose delivery passes

stages.name: reputation_matches_checks
stages.note: the trust layer moved a score without a matching Referral check, e.g. credit for a delivery whose citations were never verified

stages.name: credential_verified
stages.note: Referral's signed credential for the hired worker must verify in Town against Referral's published key, and name that worker
